name: srai_decoded_as_srli
why: the decoder drops instr[30] for OP-IMM shifts, so SRAI shifts in zeros

name: store_offset_from_rs2_field
why: the S immediate takes its low five bits from the rs2 field, the I-type position

name: slt_compares_unsigned
why: SLT and SLTI compare unsigned, so negative operands order wrongly

name: shift_amount_not_masked
why: SLL shifts by the whole 32-bit operand instead of its low five bits

name: x0_writable
why: the register file stores writes to x0, so x0 no longer reads zero

name: imem_write_address_truncated
why: the program loader drops imem_waddr[5], so words 32..63 overwrite 0..31

name: data_address_not_word_aligned
why: the byte address bits [4:0] index the data memory instead of word bits [6:2]

name: bge_not_taken_on_equal
why: BGE behaves as a strict greater-than and falls through on equal operands

name: jalr_keeps_bit0
why: JALR does not clear bit 0 of the computed target

name: load_skips_memory_wait
why: a load goes from M straight to write-back and writes the address instead of the loaded word
